reuse.why: Correctly extends the existing getMonthWideCategories and getBudgetData selectors, but writes its own #fixed regex instead of using the tag parsing in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText), with subtly different delimiter rules.

duplication.why: The fixed-group lookup is one helper, though the same 'fetch fixed groups then filter by cat_group' step is repeated in both selectors.

placement.why: The rule sits with the other month-wide exclusion rules in budget/actions.ts, but tag-matching semantics belong to shared/tags.ts.

scope.why: Only the two selectors, a test block and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Mixing an SQL rule (NO_SAVED_TEMPLATES) with a post-query JS filter and a private tag regex that can diverge from how notes tags are parsed elsewhere makes the exclusion logic harder to reason about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts FIXED_TAG regex re-implements note tag detection instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: FIXED_TAG /(?<![\w#])#fixed(?![\w-])/ is a reshaped version of the tag delimiter logic in shared/tags.ts.

one_place.where: getFixedGroupIds in budget/actions.ts, applied by both month-wide selectors getMonthWideCategories and getBudgetData.
